description: Execution contract for a critical synthesis of theory, with or without systematic searching. It has a method (search, screening and selection, appraisal when appropriate, extraction, synthesis protocol) and findings (the conceptual reconstruction, the theoretical tensions, whether the literature already addresses them, the interpretive synthesis); it has no estimator, dataset or identification strategy. Stages here are capability groups, not manuscript sections: a journal genre need not have Methods and Results headings. Independent of discipline. Status EXTRACTED: it fixes order and conditions, carries no method content and has not been checked against how researchers in this tradition work.

contribution.activity: framing the contribution the synthesis could make; whether it makes one is not decided here

literature.activity: reconstructing what the prior literature says, from full text: theories, constructs, stated assumptions and mechanisms
literature.manuscript: theoretical background, or the first part of the synthesis itself

methods.activity: the review method: how the literature was searched, screened, selected, appraised (when appropriate), extracted and synthesised
methods.manuscript: a method section where the genre has one; otherwise stated where the genre allows (the introduction, an appendix)

results.activity: the findings of the synthesis: the conceptual reconstruction, the theoretical tensions found, whether the literature already addresses them, and the interpretive synthesis
results.manuscript: findings, analysis, or sections named after the ideas; the genre may have no Results heading

discussion.activity: what the synthesis implies for theory, and what it does not establish

steps.title: Search strategy: streams, sources, queries, date range, scope (declared and adopted by the researcher)
Screening and selection: criteria, procedure and the log of decisions
Appraisal of the included studies (when the review type calls for it)

applicability.justification: the adopted protocol states that no appraisal is performed in this review, and why

steps.title: Extraction protocol: what is taken from each study and by which reading protocols
Synthesis protocol: how the reconstruction is compared and how a tension is judged to exist
Reconstruct the theories from the full texts (landscape build)
Reconstruct constructs, stated assumptions and explanatory mechanisms
Compare the theories and their scopes, units and levels of analysis (the researcher's reading; recorded)
Decide which proposed tensions and implied assumptions stand (each decision recorded with its reason)
Inspect whether the literature already recognises or resolves each tension (inspection record; no absence is inferred from a search)

on_condition.reason: an inspected paper already addresses the tension: restate it against that paper or drop it

steps.title: The interpretive synthesis: the conceptual map, the tensions that stand and what they mean (the researcher's product)
Propose possible reconceptualisations for the researcher's review

applicability.justification: reconceptualisation is the purpose of a critical synthesis or of theory development

steps.title: State what the synthesis does not establish (the inspected set, the corpus, the full texts missing)
